bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to education finance; appropriating money for student mental health grants.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1. APPROPRIATION; STUDENT MENTAL HEALTH GRANTS.

Subdivision 1.

Department of Education.

The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of education in the fiscal year designated.

Subd. 2.

Student mental health grants.

(a) For grants to organizations working to improve student mental health:

$

.......

.....

2027

(b) The commissioner must award grants to organizations that provide elementary or secondary school students with opportunities to disconnect from electronic devices and social media, be physically active, engage in collaborative experiences, and develop in-person relationships with other students. A grant applicant must demonstrate that its program improves mental health outcomes for students.

(c) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.

EFFECTIVE DATE.

This section is effective July 1, 2026.
additions: The sum indicated in this section is appropriated from the general fund to the commissioner of education in the fiscal year designated.
(a) For grants to organizations working to improve student mental health:

(b) The commissioner must award grants to organizations that provide elementary or secondary school students with opportunities to disconnect from electronic devices and social media, be physically active, engage in collaborative experiences, and develop in-person relationships with other students. A grant applicant must demonstrate that its program improves mental health outcomes for students.
(c) This is a onetime appropriation and is available until June 30, 2029.
